Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 92a8046c9d952a2a7d21dfcd3afadc72a0bc0f72 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2018 09:35:15 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] gpio: winbond: fix ISA_BUS_API dependency

The newly added GPIO driver for winbond chipsets causes a
circular dependency warning in Kconfig:

drivers/gpio/Kconfig:13:error: recursive dependency detected!
drivers/gpio/Kconfig:13:	symbol GPIOLIB is selected by STX104
drivers/iio/adc/Kconfig:699:	symbol STX104 depends on ISA_BUS_API
arch/Kconfig:830:	symbol ISA_BUS_API is selected by GPIO_WINBOND
drivers/gpio/Kconfig:701:	symbol GPIO_WINBOND depends on GPIOLIB

The underlying problem is that ISA_BUS_API is not meant to be selected by
device drivers, instead it is provided by the architectures that support
ISA add-on card devices, or in case of x86 have this explicitly enabled.

This particular driver appears to be different from the other ISA_BUS_API
based drivers, in that it is not normally an add-on card (ISA or PC104)
but instead is an LPC-attached component on the mainboard. We already
support other functionality provided by this chip, at least
drivers/watchdog/w83627hf_wdt.c and drivers/hwmon/w83627ehf.c, plus
there is a discovery function for this hardware in
drivers/parport/parport_pc.c.

If we want to use this driver without having to enable CONFIG_EXPERT,
it might be better to not use the isa_bus_type for it, but rather
turn it into a platform_driver, acpi_driver or add an MFD for it that
is shared with the wdt and hwmon portions and does the probing.

For now, this patch fixes the dependency by changing 'select' into
'depends on'.

Cc: William Breathitt Gray <vilhelm.gray@gmail.com>
Cc: Guenter Roeck <linux@roeck-us.net>
Cc: Maciej S. Szmigiero <mail@maciej.szmigiero.name>
Cc: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Fixes: a0d65009411c ("gpio: winbond: Add driver")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpio/Kconfig b/drivers/gpio/Kconfig
index 440af077cc76..8dbb2280538d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpio/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/gpio/Kconfig
@@ -700,7 +700,7 @@ config GPIO_TS5500
 
 config GPIO_WINBOND
 	tristate "Winbond Super I/O GPIO support"
-	select ISA_BUS_API
+	depends on ISA_BUS_API
 	help
 	  This option enables support for GPIOs found on Winbond Super I/O
 	  chips.
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpio/Kconfig`**
   - The configuration option for `GPIO_WINBOND` was modified from `select ISA_BUS_API` to `depends on ISA_BUS_API`. 

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change from `select` to `depends on` for the `GPIO_WINBOND` configuration option addresses a circular dependency issue in the Kconfig system. This modification ensures that the `GPIO_WINBOND` driver does not incorrectly select the `ISA_BUS_API`, which is intended to be provided by the architecture rather than by device drivers. This adjustment allows the driver to function without requiring the `CONFIG_EXPERT` option, thereby improving its usability and integration within the kernel configuration.

Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a circular dependency in the Kconfig configuration system, where the `GPIO_WINBOND` driver incorrectly selected `ISA_BUS_API`, leading to a recursive dependency warning. This was due to the nature of the `GPIO_WINBOND` driver being different from typical ISA_BUS_API drivers, as it is not an add-on card but an LPC-attached component on the mainboard.

Here is the patch:
 config GPIO_WINBOND
 	tristate "Winbond Super I/O GPIO support"
-	select ISA_BUS_API
+	depends on ISA_BUS_API
 	help
 	  This option enables support for GPIOs found on Winbond Super I/O

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
select ISA_BUS_API
depends on GPIOLIB
depends on ISA_BUS_API
```
Reason:
The `select ISA_BUS_API` statement in the `GPIO_WINBOND` configuration creates a circular dependency because `GPIOLIB` is selected by `STX104`, which in turn depends on `ISA_BUS_API`. This results in a recursive dependency warning as the `GPIO_WINBOND` driver is incorrectly trying to select a dependency that should only be provided by the architecture.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
depends on ISA_BUS_API
```
Reason:
Changing `select ISA_BUS_API` to `depends on ISA_BUS_API` resolves the circular dependency issue by ensuring that the `GPIO_WINBOND` driver only requires `ISA_BUS_API` to be enabled without trying to select it. This aligns the driver with the intended architecture support and avoids the recursive dependency warning.
